achievements.title: National-Level Achievement in Robotics and Logistics
achievements.description: The team secured All India Rank 4 among more than 3,000 teams across all themes and more than 500 teams within its specific theme. The achievement followed a seven-month development programme involving multi-holonomic logistics robots, computer vision, path planning, and real-time decision-making. The team ranked among the top 0.5% nationwide.
highlights: More than 3,000 teams across all themes
